diluc.name: Diluc
diluc.title: The Dark Side of Dawn
diluc.description: The owner of Dawn Winery and a hidden protector of Mondstadt. Diluc fights with a burning passion, using his Pyro abilities to cleanse the darkness from Teyvat.
diluc.bioSub: "Justice is not a privilege. It is a right."
bioContent: Diluc is the enigmatic owner of the Dawn Winery in Mondstadt.
By day, he is a wealthy businessman. By night, he is a vigilante who uses his Pyro abilities to fight the Abyss Order and protect the innocent.
His past is marked by tragedy, including the loss of his father and his disillusionment with the Knights of Favonius.

features.title: Pyro
features.desc: Wields the power of fire to incinerate his enemies.

features.title: Claymore
features.desc: Fights with a massive claymore, dealing heavy damage.

features.title: Vigilante
features.desc: Protects Mondstadt from the shadows.

skills.name: Searing Onslaught
skills.desc: Diluc slashes forward, dealing Pyro damage with a burning trail.

skills.name: Dawn
skills.desc: Diluc summons a phoenix that deals massive AoE Pyro damage, pushing enemies back.

skills.name: Relentless
skills.desc: Increases damage when Diluc's HP is below 50%.

skills.name: Blessing of Phoenix
skills.desc: Grants a small Pyro shield after using Elemental Burst.

keqing.name: Keqing
keqing.title: The Driving Thunder
keqing.description: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing, Keqing is a decisive and independent leader who believes in the power of humanity. Her Electro abilities are as swift as lightning.
bioContent: Keqing is the Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing, one of the most influential figures in Liyue.
She is known for her pragmatic approach and her belief that humanity should forge its own destiny, without relying on the gods.
Her Electro abilities allow her to move with blinding speed, striking enemies before they can react.

features.title: Electro
features.desc: Strikes with the speed and power of lightning.

features.title: Sword
features.desc: Wields a sword with unmatched agility.

features.title: Liyue Qixing
features.desc: A leader of Liyue's ruling council.

skills.name: Stellar Restoration
skills.desc: Keqing throws a lightning stiletto, dealing Electro damage and teleporting to its location.

skills.name: Starward Sword
skills.desc: Keqing unleashes a flurry of lightning slashes, dealing massive AoE Electro damage.

skills.name: Thundering Penance
skills.desc: Electro-infused attacks deal bonus damage.

skills.name: Aristocratic Dignity
skills.desc: Increases damage when Keqing uses her Elemental Skill.

klee.name: Klee
klee.title: The Spark Knight
klee.description: The Spark Knight of the Knights of Favonius, Klee is a young and explosive girl who loves bombs, adventure, and causing chaos wherever she goes.
bioContent: Klee is the Spark Knight of the Knights of Favonius.
She is a young girl with an endless fascination with explosions, constantly inventing new bombs and causing 'minor accidents' across Mondstadt.
Despite her destructive tendencies, she has a pure heart and always fights to protect her friends.

features.title: Explosives Expert
features.desc: Uses bombs and explosives to deal devastating Pyro damage.

features.title: Catalyst
features.desc: Fights with a catalyst, hurling bombs at her enemies.

features.title: Knights of Favonius
features.desc: A young but enthusiastic member of the Knights.

skills.name: Jumpy Dumpty
skills.desc: Klee throws a bouncing bomb that explodes three times, dealing Pyro damage.

skills.name: Sparks 'n' Splash
skills.desc: Klee unleashes a devastating explosion, dealing massive AoE Pyro damage.

skills.name: Explosive Spark
skills.desc: Increases Pyro damage after using her Skill.

skills.name: Pounding Surprise
skills.desc: Increases damage based on her ATK.

ganyu.name: Ganyu
ganyu.title: The Plenilune Gaze
ganyu.description: A half-qilin secretary of the Liyue Qixing. Ganyu is a gentle and hardworking soul who uses her Cryo abilities to protect Liyue.
ganyu.bioSub: "For Liyue, I will give my all."
bioContent: Ganyu is a half-qilin and the secretary of the Liyue Qixing.
She has served Liyue for over 3000 years, working tirelessly to ensure the prosperity of the city.
Her Cryo abilities make her a formidable archer, capable of freezing her enemies from a distance.

features.title: Cryo
features.desc: Freezes enemies with the power of ice.

features.title: Bow
features.desc: A master archer with unmatched precision.

features.title: Liyue Qixing
features.desc: Dedicated secretary to the ruling council.

skills.name: Frostflake Arrow
skills.desc: Ganyu fires a frostflake arrow that deals AoE Cryo damage on impact.

skills.name: Trail of the Qilin
skills.desc: Ganyu leaves an ice lotus that taunts enemies and deals Cryo damage.

skills.name: Celestial Shower
skills.desc: Ganyu rains down icicles, dealing AoE Cryo damage over time.

skills.name: Undivided Heart
skills.desc: Increases critical rate of frostflake arrows.

raiden.name: Raiden Shogun
raiden.title: The Eternal Sovereign
raiden.description: The Electro Archon of Inazuma, the Raiden Shogun rules with an iron fist, pursuing the ideal of 'eternity' for her nation.
bioContent: Raiden Shogun is the Electro Archon of Inazuma.
She seeks to create an eternal paradise for her people, freezing Inazuma in time to protect it from the erosion of change.
She wields a polearm that can summon the power of lightning itself, striking down her enemies with divine fury.

features.title: Electro Archon
features.desc: The ruler of Inazuma, wielding the power of lightning.

features.title: Polearm
features.desc: Fights with a polearm that channels divine energy.

features.title: Eternity
features.desc: Pursues the ideal of eternal peace for Inazuma.

skills.name: Transcendence: Baleful Omen
skills.desc: Raiden summons a lightning eye that deals Electro damage to enemies.

skills.name: Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu
skills.desc: Raiden unleashes a devastating lightning slash, dealing massive AoE Electro damage.

skills.name: Wishes Unnumbered
skills.desc: Increases party damage based on energy consumed.

skills.name: Enlightened One
skills.desc: Increases Electro damage for the party.

venti.name: Venti
venti.title: The Bard of Mondstadt
venti.description: A free-spirited bard who travels the world with his lyre. He is also the Anemo Archon, Barbatos, watching over Mondstadt from the shadows.
venti.bioSub: "The wind carries the songs of freedom."
bioContent: Venti is a wandering bard of Mondstadt, known for his love of wine and song.
He is also the Anemo Archon, Barbatos, one of the Seven who rules the wind.
He uses his Anemo abilities to protect Mondstadt and spread the ideals of freedom and song.

features.title: Anemo Archon
features.desc: The god of wind and freedom.

features.title: Bow
features.desc: Fights with a bow, shooting arrows infused with wind.

features.title: Bard
features.desc: Spreads the joy of song and poetry.

skills.name: Skyward Sonnet
skills.desc: Venti summons a wind current that lifts enemies into the air.

skills.name: Wind's Grand Ode
skills.desc: Venti creates a massive vortex that pulls in enemies and deals Anemo damage.

skills.name: Windrider
skills.desc: Reduces stamina consumption while gliding.

skills.name: Poetic Verses
skills.desc: Increases energy regeneration for the party.

hutao.name: Hu Tao
hutao.title: The Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
hutao.description: The 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, Hu Tao is a mischievous and eccentric girl who handles the affairs of the dead.
hutao.bioSub: "Life is a celebration, and death is just part of the party!"
bioContent: Hu Tao is the 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor in Liyue.
She treats death as a natural part of life, and her quirky personality hides a deep wisdom about the world.
Her Pyro abilities allow her to dance between life and death, burning her enemies with ghostly flames.

features.title: Pyro
features.desc: Wields flames that dance between life and death.

features.title: Polearm
features.desc: Fights with a polearm that burns with ghostly fire.

features.title: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
features.desc: Handles the affairs of the dead.

skills.name: Guide to Afterlife
skills.desc: Hu Tao consumes HP to deal Pyro damage and enter a boosted state.

skills.name: Spirit Soother
skills.desc: Hu Tao unleashes a wave of ghostly flames, dealing AoE Pyro damage and healing herself.

skills.name: Flame of Life
skills.desc: Increases damage when HP is below 50%.

skills.name: The More the Merrier
skills.desc: Increases party critical rate after using her Skill.

zhongli.name: Zhongli
zhongli.title: The Consultant of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
zhongli.description: A mysterious consultant who works with the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. He is also the Geo Archon, Morax, who has lived for over 6000 years.
zhongli.bioSub: "I will remember you, for all eternity."
bioContent: Zhongli is a consultant at the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor in Liyue.
He is actually the Geo Archon, Morax, who has guided Liyue for over 6000 years.
His Geo abilities allow him to summon stone pillars and create impenetrable shields to protect his allies.

features.title: Geo Archon
features.desc: The god of contracts and stone.

features.title: Polearm
features.desc: Fights with a polearm that commands the earth.

features.title: Shield
features.desc: Creates the strongest shields in Teyvat.

skills.name: Dominus Lapidis
skills.desc: Zhongli summons a stone pillar that deals Geo damage and can resonate with other Geo constructs.

skills.name: Jade Shield
skills.desc: Zhongli creates a powerful shield that absorbs damage based on his HP.

skills.name: Planet Befall
skills.desc: Zhongli summons a meteor that deals massive Geo damage and petrifies enemies.

skills.name: Dominance of Earth
skills.desc: Increases shield strength and damage for the party.

ayaka.name: Ayaka
ayaka.title: The Shirasagi Himegimi
ayaka.description: The eldest daughter of the Kamisato Clan and the Yashiro Commissioner's sister. Ayaka is a graceful and refined warrior who fights with the power of Cryo.
ayaka.bioSub: "The frost within my heart... will never melt."
bioContent: Ayaka is the eldest daughter of the Kamisato Clan in Inazuma.
She is known as the Shirasagi Himegimi for her grace and elegance.
Her Cryo abilities allow her to move with blinding speed, freezing her enemies before they can react.

features.title: Cryo
features.desc: Wields the power of ice with grace and precision.

features.title: Sword
features.desc: Fights with a sword that channels frost.

features.title: Kamisato Clan
features.desc: A noble family of Inazuma.

skills.name: Kamisato Art: Hyouka
skills.desc: Ayaka summons a frost bloom that deals Cryo damage and launches enemies.

skills.name: Kamisato Art: Soumetsu
skills.desc: Ayaka unleashes a storm of frost, dealing massive Cryo damage and forming an ice vortex.

skills.name: Frostsake
skills.desc: Increases damage when Ayaka is affected by Cryo.

skills.name: Kamisato Art: Dance of the Shirasagi
skills.desc: Increases Cryo damage after using her Skill.

nahida.name: Nahida
nahida.title: The God of Wisdom
nahida.description: The Dendro Archon and the God of Wisdom, Nahida is the youngest of the Seven and the ruler of Sumeru. She uses her abilities to guide the people toward knowledge.
nahida.bioSub: "Wisdom is the light that shines through the darkness of ignorance."
bioContent: Nahida is the Dendro Archon and the God of Wisdom, ruling over Sumeru.
She is known as the youngest of the Seven, but her wisdom is vast and ancient.
Her Dendro abilities allow her to manipulate the power of life and nature, guiding her people toward enlightenment.

features.title: Dendro Archon
features.desc: The god of wisdom and nature.

features.title: Catalyst
features.desc: Fights with a catalyst that channels the power of life.

features.title: Wisdom
features.desc: Guides the people of Sumeru toward knowledge.

skills.name: All Schemes to Know
skills.desc: Nahida marks enemies, dealing Dendro damage and linking them together.

skills.name: Illusory Heart
skills.desc: Nahida creates a massive domain of wisdom, dealing Dendro damage and empowering her abilities.

skills.name: Compassion for the Lost
skills.desc: Increases damage based on the party's elemental mastery.

skills.name: Seed of Knowledge
skills.desc: Reduces enemy defenses after triggering reactions.

xiangling.name: Xiangling
xiangling.title: The Chef of Liyue
xiangling.description: The head chef of the Wanmin Restaurant in Liyue, Xiangling is a passionate cook who wields Pyro abilities and fights with a polearm.
xiangling.bioSub: "Cooking and fighting are both about passion and precision."
bioContent: Xiangling is the head chef of the Wanmin Restaurant in Liyue.
She is passionate about cooking and loves to experiment with new ingredients and flavors.
Her Pyro abilities allow her to cook her enemies as well as her meals, fighting with a fiery polearm.

features.title: Pyro
features.desc: Cooks her enemies with fiery attacks.

features.title: Polearm
features.desc: Fights with a polearm that burns with passion.

features.title: Chef
features.desc: The head chef of the Wanmin Restaurant.

skills.name: Guoba Attack
skills.desc: Xiangling summons Guoba, who deals Pyro damage to enemies.

skills.name: Pyronado
skills.desc: Xiangling creates a spinning fire vortex, dealing AoE Pyro damage.

skills.name: Hot and Sour
skills.desc: Increases damage of Guoba's attacks.

skills.name: Chef's Expertise
skills.desc: Increases party attack when using a dish.

barbara.name: Barbara
barbara.title: The Deaconess of Mondstadt
barbara.description: The beloved deaconess of the Church of Favonius, Barbara is a kind and caring healer who uses her Hydro abilities to protect and heal her allies.
bioContent: Barbara is the deaconess of the Church of Favonius in Mondstadt.
She is known for her kind heart and her beautiful voice, which she uses to comfort the people of the city.
Her Hydro abilities allow her to heal her allies and cleanse them of debuffs.

features.title: Hydro
features.desc: Uses the power of water to heal and protect.

features.title: Catalyst
features.desc: Fights with a catalyst that channels healing energy.

features.title: Deaconess
features.desc: A beloved figure of faith in Mondstadt.

skills.name: Whisper of Water
skills.desc: Barbara heals her allies with a soothing melody of water.

skills.name: Shining Miracle
skills.desc: Barbara creates a healing aura that restores health over time.

skills.name: Healing Spirit
skills.desc: Increases healing done to allies.

skills.name: Pure Water
skills.desc: Cleanses debuffs from allies.

fischl.name: Fischl
fischl.title: The Prinzessin der Verurteilung
fischl.description: The Prinzessin der Verurteilung, Fischl is an eccentric girl who claims to come from another world. She fights alongside her raven companion, Oz, with Electro abilities.
bioContent: Fischl is the Prinzessin der Verurteilung, an eccentric girl who claims to be from another world.
She fights alongside her raven companion, Oz, who channels her Electro abilities.
Despite her dramatic personality, she is a skilled fighter and a loyal friend.

features.title: Electro
features.desc: Channels lightning through her companion Oz.

features.title: Bow
features.desc: Fights with a bow from a distance.

features.title: Oz
features.desc: Her loyal raven companion.

skills.name: Nightrider
skills.desc: Fischl summons Oz, who attacks enemies with Electro.

skills.name: Midnight Phantasmagoria
skills.desc: Fischl and Oz unleash a storm of lightning, dealing AoE Electro damage.

skills.name: Stellar Predator
skills.desc: Increases damage of Oz's attacks.

skills.name: Thunderbolt
skills.desc: Increases Electro damage for the party.

bennett.name: Bennett
bennett.title: The Unlucky Adventurer
bennett.description: A young adventurer cursed with incredible bad luck, Bennett is a kind and optimistic person who fights with a burning passion using Pyro abilities.
bennett.bioSub: "Even if I'm unlucky, I'll never give up!"
bioContent: Bennett is a young adventurer from Mondstadt, cursed with terrible luck.
Despite his misfortunes, he remains optimistic and kind, always looking for the silver lining.
His Pyro abilities allow him to fight with fiery determination, supporting his allies with incredible power.

features.title: Pyro
features.desc: Fights with burning determination.

features.title: Sword
features.desc: Wields a sword with fiery passion.

features.title: Unlucky
features.desc: Cursed with terrible luck, but never gives up.

skills.name: Passion Overload
skills.desc: Bennett unleashes a burning strike that deals Pyro damage.

skills.name: Fantastic Voyage
skills.desc: Bennett creates a field that heals allies and increases their attack.

skills.name: Fervor
skills.desc: Reduces cooldown of his Elemental Skill.

skills.name: Reckless Adventure
skills.desc: Increases damage when using his Skill.

sucrose.name: Sucrose
sucrose.title: The Alchemist of Mondstadt
sucrose.description: An assistant alchemist who is passionate about the study of bio-alchemy. Sucrose uses her Anemo abilities to support her allies and control the battlefield.
sucrose.bioSub: "Science is the key to understanding the world."
bioContent: Sucrose is an assistant alchemist at the Knights of Favonius.
She is deeply passionate about the study of bio-alchemy and the secrets of life.
Her Anemo abilities allow her to control the battlefield, grouping enemies together and boosting her allies' elemental mastery.

features.title: Anemo
features.desc: Controls the wind to support her allies.

features.title: Catalyst
features.desc: Uses a catalyst to channel her alchemical power.

features.title: Alchemist
features.desc: Passionate about bio-alchemy.

skills.name: Wind Spirit
skills.desc: Sucrose summons a wind spirit that deals Anemo damage and pulls enemies.

skills.name: Forbidden Creation
skills.desc: Sucrose creates a large vortex that deals Anemo damage and boosts ally elemental mastery.

skills.name: Catalyst Conversion
skills.desc: Increases elemental mastery for the party.

skills.name: Alchemical Experiment
skills.desc: Increases damage when using her Skill.
